subject: Remuneration structure review — L3 SDE standard offer (Samantha Jones)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recommended remuneration for Samantha Jones (L3 SDE)

Hi Olga / Laura,

We're ready to extend a standard L3 (SDE) offer to Samantha Jones (candidate id: C-9872). Below is the recommendation from TA + comp team after benchmarking and manager input. Attaching the draft offer letter and the SDE2 internal guide.

Recommendation (standard band):
- Base salary: $150,000
- Annual target bonus: 10% of base (on-target)
- Equity: 8,000 RSUs, 4-year vest (25% cliff / monthly thereafter)
- Signing bonus: none (standard)
- Start date: target 2027-01-11

Rationale: market comp for L3 SDE in SF comparable companies shows base 140-160k, total comp tilts with equity. Manager requests standard RSU grant to preserve comp equity across team. No relocation or sign-on requested.

Action: Olga — can you please review total comp and confirm we can extend at these levels? If you see a need to bump base or sign-on, flag and we'll route to Markus for final comp approval.

Attachments: L3-offer-letter-olga-draft.docx, SDE2_Offer_Guide.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recommended remuneration for Samantha Jones (L3 SDE)

Thanks Marissa — quick questions before I sign off:
1) Equity: is 8,000 RSUs aligned with comp band mid-point for L3 in SF? I want to avoid a manager-exception later.
2) Bonus: 10% is typical, but does the manager expect a higher variable based on performance profile?
3) Any comp history or counter-offer risk from her current employer?

If all is standard, I can approve today. If the manager is pushing for any top-of-band adjustments, we should escalate to Markus for sign-off.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Engineering Manager, Compute Services | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recommended remuneration for Samantha Jones (L3 SDE)

Olga / team — FYI on banding: for L3 (SDE) in SF we typically target 7k-9k RSUs at mid-band. 8k sits squarely at midpoint. Base of $150k with 10% bonus is within band. No approval required from me for these numbers.

Notes:
- If candidate has a competing cash-heavy counter, consider offering a one-time signing bonus up to $10k (manager-approved) to bridge.
- For any >10% bonus target or >9k RSUs, escalate to me and finance for budget sign-off.

Approve as-is.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Total Compensation | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference — official offer (L3 SDE)

Hi Samantha — great speaking with you last week. We're excited to invite you to join Redwood Inference as a Level 3 Software Engineer. Please find the key terms below and the formal offer attached. We can finalize on DocuSign once you confirm.

Summary of offer:
- Title: Software Engineer (L3)
- Base salary: $150,000 per year
- Annual target bonus: 10% of base (eligible after start)
- Equity: 8,000 Restricted Stock Units (4-year vesting; 1-year cliff)
- Benefits: standard Redwood benefits (medical/dental/401k)
- Start date: Jan 11, 2027 (flexible)

Attachments: L3-offer-letter-olga-draft.docx, SDE2_Offer_Guide.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/abcd-1234-offer

Please let me know if you have any questions — once you're comfortable we can send the DocuSign packet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
